answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that GAPO enhances diversity in creative writing tasks such as poetry, storytelling, and dialogue while preserving coherence...
answer_1.outputs: haikus, poems, stories, dialogues, jokes, song choruses, mystery openings, and idea pitches

answer_2.quote: We then computed two complementary diversity metrics: (1) average embedding distance between all pairs of outputs, which captures semantic diversity, and (2) average 1-Self-BLEU score, which measures lexical diversity.
